answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed tasks whose results are independently checked by randomly selected peers, with rewards released after a challenge window. A new identity starts with no reputation, so splitting into many accounts does not multiply voting power; each must build a history through costly, verifiable work. Colluding reviewers risk losing their own stake when audits expose false approvals. Whether a task concerns zenith, tundra, or lotus, the attacker must fund real effort and expose collateral to slashing.
